body.name: Conditional-pair peeling
body.construction: At state \(S\subseteq V\), maintain each conditional covariance by rank-one Schur updates and normalize it to \(R_e^{(S)}=\operatorname{corr}(R_e[V\setminus S,V\setminus S]-R_e[V\setminus S,S]R_e[S,S]^{-1}R_e[S,V\setminus S])\). Test every ordered pair \(i,j\in V\setminus S\) for \(R_{e,ij}^{(S)2}/(1-R_{e,ij}^{(S)2})=(d_{ei}/d_{ej})R_{0,ij}^{(S)2}/(1-R_{0,ij}^{(S)2})\) and a common correlation sign over all \(e\). If exactly one ordered pair passes, append its first vertex to \(S\); otherwise return \(\mathsf{FiberCert}(R,d)\). On completing an order, return its support only if the positivity, squared-cross-product, and sign checks in \(\mathsf{FiberCert}\) pass; otherwise return \(\mathsf{FiberCert}(R,d)\).
